name: True Scion
body:
You can master blood powers far beyond your normal training.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary bloodrager, bloodline

Benefit(s): You count as 4 levels higher, up to your HD, for the purpose of determining which bloodline powers and defenses you have access to, as well as their effects and saving throws.
